decisions.reason: As a close-to-core turnaround software product with clear strategic fit in integrated airport operations, it remains a valuable option to keep open because continuation is likely cheap relative to the learning and cross-selling potential still available.

This apron connectivity module still leverages the firm's installed base and integration capabilities, so despite limited visibility as a standalone offer its option value remains higher than the likely cost of keeping it on the market.

The apron resource management module supports the firm's end-to-end automation direction and can still gain value through bundling with adjacent apron solutions, which justifies continued retention while demand further clarifies.

The controller safety alert service fits the firm's safety and tower positioning, and although adoption and validation may take longer and make outcomes more uncertain, it is still worth keeping as a strategic option for another year.
